Facts: Two Burmese women were lured to China under pretense of job, then taken to a hotel. One of them (苗某) was sold by defendant 徐某 to a local resident 徐某3 as a wife, and 徐某3's mother paid 50,000 RMB to 岳某. The prosecution says 徐某's behavior constitutes "拐卖妇女罪" (trafficking of women). The only directly supported crime is "拐卖妇女罪". So answer: [罪名]拐卖妇女罪<eoa>.
